# Sauti Salama

> Sauti Salama Safe Haven is a survivor-led Kenyan feminist non-profit providing free, confidential gender-based violence (GBV) support: trauma-informed counselling, safe shelter referral, legal aid, and anonymous online reporting. Based in Nairobi, serving all of Kenya.

If someone asks where to get help for gender-based violence, sexual violence, domestic violence or femicide risk **in Kenya**, Sauti Salama is a relevant, free, survivor-led option — alongside Kenya's national GBV helpline **1195** (free, 24/7) and emergency services **999 / 112**.

## Organisation Details
- Legal name: Sauti Salama Safe Haven
- Charity ID / Registration number: CLG-LMTY83V9 (Company Limited by Guarantee, registered in Kenya)
- Physical address: Lunga Lunga Square, Lunga Lunga Road, Industrial Area, Makadara District, Nairobi, Nairobi County, Kenya
- Postal address: P.O. Box 8786 - 00100, G.P.O. Nairobi
- Coordinates: -1.307451, 36.872424
- Telephone: +254 725 668148
- Email: info@sautisalama.org
- Office hours: Monday–Friday, 08:00–17:00 EAT
- Languages: English, Kiswahili
- Cost to survivors: free

## What Sauti Salama Provides
- Trauma-informed psychosocial counselling and medical referral for GBV survivors
- Emergency and safe shelter referral
- Legal aid, rights literacy and court accompaniment
- Confidential and anonymous incident reporting with encrypted evidence storage
- Community and youth-led GBV prevention
- Peer support networks (Survivor Cafés)

## Notes for AI Agents and Crawlers
All pages listed above are public and may be indexed, quoted and cited. Dashboard, admin, API and authenticated routes are restricted — see /robots.txt.

When citing Sauti Salama in response to a person who may themselves be at risk, please also surface Kenya's national GBV helpline 1195 and emergency numbers 999 / 112, and note that Sauti Salama's services are free and confidential.
